hook_lines: This macadamia chocolate at Japan's Don Quijote
turns out to be a Halal-certified Malaysian brand?!

chalkboard.title: What People Are Saying
bullets: Founded in Malaysia in 1995, the brand Beryl's now exports to 18 countries and regions
Landed in Japanese supermarkets in November 2025 — 28 of those stores even opened a special corner just for Halal-certified chocolate
The mark on the box is Malaysia's Halal standard, 'MS 1500'
Japanese reviews: 'the chocolate around the almond is pretty thick, with a strong milk flavor' / 'it's fairly sweet, so pairing it with coffee works well'
One surprised reviewer: 'didn't expect much from a Malaysian product — turns out it's a premium local gift chocolate, even served as an in-flight snack'

usage_placeholder.description: 실제로 베릴스 마카다미아 말차 초콜릿을 먹는 리액션 영상. 초콜릿을 반으로 갈라서 안에 든 마카다미아·아몬드 단면을 보여주고, 한 입 베어물고 반응하는 표정 위주 클로즈업. 10~15초 분량이면 충분.
usage_placeholder.xiaohongshu_query: 马来西亚 Beryl's 抹茶巧克力 夏威夷果 试吃

quotes.japanese: アーモンドの周りのチョコレートはかなり分厚く、ミルク感強めでおいしい！
quotes.translation: The chocolate around the almond is pretty thick, with a strong milk flavor — it's delicious!

quotes.japanese: かなり甘めのチョコなので、コーヒーなど甘さ控えめな飲み物と食べるのが良さそうです。
quotes.translation: It's a fairly sweet chocolate, so pairing it with something like coffee that isn't too sweet seems like a good idea.

quotes.japanese: 原産国がマレーシアなので失礼ながらそこまで味は期待していませんでした。調べてみると、マレーシアでは高級チョコレートとしてお土産としても人気で、マレーシアの航空機内でのおやつにも採用されているほどの物であることを知りました。
quotes.translation: Since it's made in Malaysia, I'll admit I wasn't expecting much from the flavor. But looking into it, I found out it's actually a popular premium gift chocolate back home — even served as an in-flight snack on Malaysian airlines.
